 Priyanka Chopra Jonas Makes a Statement in an Embellished Burgundy Gown for Diwali
 by Shruthi Singh | Updated on Nov 2, 2026, 20:59 IST 
 Follow On Select femina as Preferred on 1 / 7 Priyanka Chopra Jonas Makes a Statement in an Embellished Burgundy Gown for Diwali 
 Miss World 2000 Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Nick Jonas hosted a Diwali celebration at their Los Angeles home, bringing together close friends for the festivities. Actress Sanya Malhotra was also among the guests who joined the couple for the occasion.
For the celebration, Priyanka wore a striking, embellished gown featuring traditional Indian craftsmanship. The deep burgundy creation was fitted through the bodice, with a corset-inspired structure and an off-the-shoulder neckline that highlighted her collarbone and shoulders. Intricate zardozi embroidery, delicate beadwork and gold-thread detailing covered the gown, creating an ornate pattern reminiscent of architectural motifs.
 2 / 7 ​​Priyanka Chopra Jonas brings festive glamour to Los Angeles in a stunning burgundy gown adorned with intricate zardozi work.​ 
 3 / 7 A celebration of Indian craftsmanship! Priyanka’s embellished burgundy gown makes a striking statement this Diwali. 
 4 / 7 ​​From intricate embroidery to rich jewel tones, Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Diwali look is a festive fashion moment.​ 
 5 / 7 ​​Priyanka adds a touch of traditional Indian artistry to her Diwali celebrations with this beautifully detailed gown.​ 
 6 / 7 ​When Indian craftsmanship meets contemporary glamour, you get a Diwali look like Priyanka’s! 
 7 / 7 Priyanka Chopra Jonas celebrates the festive season in a show-stopping ensemble that puts traditional embroidery in the spotlight.
